entities.summary: Grahanandan Singh was an Indian field hockey player who won two gold medals, at the 1948 and 1952 Summer Olympics. There is a documentary film on the team. Grahanandan Singh was a athletes & competitors from Faisalabad (1926-02-18, Faisalabad–2014-12-07). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
